profile_text.body:
ELLIS, also known as the European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems, is a nonprofit organization headquartered in Europe. According to its website, it is a pan-European AI network of excellence that connects top researchers in machine learning and related fields, with the stated aim of securing lasting international leadership of AI made in Europe and creating a multi-centric AI research laboratory. Its activities are organized through Programs, Sites, and a PhD program.

The site describes ELLIS Programs as focused on theoretical foundations, algorithms, and applications such as health and climate, led by ELLIS Fellows and Scholars. The ELLIS PhD and Postdoc Program pairs students with researchers across Europe and offers international exchanges, joint supervision, and a research community. The network of Sites is described as hubs for AI research, composed of local AI research institutions and universities or newly created Institutes. The site also notes that the University of Stuttgart has been a member of the network since 2021, that the ELLIS Doctoral Symposium 2026 was organized by ELLIS Unit Lisbon and brought together more than 100 PhD students, postdocs, researchers, and AI experts, and it lists a postdoc position on AI and machine learning methods for target identification for neuropsychiatric diseases at Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC).

No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for ELLIS.
